name: lookmenot-extension
description: Open-source Langfuse trace reader browser extension for AI agent debugging and LLM trace inspection.

scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && npm run lint:firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir artifacts --filename lookmenot-{version}-firefox.zip --overwrite-dest
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build:chrome && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome --artifacts-dir artifacts --filename lookmenot-{version}-chrome.zip --overwrite-dest
